Focus county detail (2024)

All six metrics per focus county, with margin of error (MOE)

Reliability reflects how large the margin of error is relative to the estimate (the coefficient of variation, CV -- Census Bureau convention): reliable CV < 15% · caution CV 15–30% · unreliable CV > 30%. Deep cross-tabs (poverty, disability, employment by veteran status) on smaller counties land in caution/unreliable more often -- treat those numbers as directional, not precise. Hover a badge for its exact CV.
